about_the_game:
Alonitaire is the classic Solitaire you've always known and love. Just Solitaire. I swear. Or so I think.

Pixelart graphics with a retro aesthetic that evoke the nostalgia of early computer games. Cards, interface, music... everything designed for you to enjoy an authentic traditional Klondike experience.

Place cards from Ace to King. Move between columns. Use the free cells. You already know how it works.

The Joker acts as master of ceremonies, adding that theatrical touch that makes each game more entertaining. Because playing alone can be... boring, right?

Features

  • Classic Klondike Solitaire - The same rules as always

  • Retro pixelart aesthetic nostalgic and detailed

  • Complete tutorial for those who need to remember how to play

  • Progression system with scoring, statistics and achievements

  • Original soundtrack composed specifically for the game

  • Multiple languages available

  • Infinite games - There's always a new deck waiting

A personal story

This game was born over 10 years ago as a project among friends. Anthony, my development partner, passed away in 2015 and the project remained unfinished for years.

Recently they sent me some of his things they found in the attic. Among them was a copy of this game. Upon discovering it was completely playable, I decided to finish it as a tribute to all those hours we spent programming together.

This one's for you, friend.

Important clarification

Despite what you may read in comments or social media, this game is NOT:

  • A roguelike

  • A deckbuilder

  • A point and click

  • A puzzle

  • A graphic adventure

It's Solitaire.

Just Solitaire.

...or so I think.
